features.name: Lazy page loading via defineRoute()
features.description: Every page is wrapped in React.lazy() via a defineRoute() helper. Each route entry stores both a Component (lazy) and a preload() function for eager prefetching.

features.name: Route-based prefetching on hover/focus
features.description: useRoutePrefetch hook returns onMouseEnter/onFocus handlers that trigger module preload. A Set-based dedup cache prevents double-loading.

features.name: Route prefetch integration in nav
features.description: Each nav link gets {...useRoutePrefetch(importFn)} spread, plus the brand/notification/avatar links have explicit prefetch wiring.

features.name: 20 lazy-loaded page routes
features.description: Complete route map: /anthologies, /anthologies/new, /anthologies/:id, /anthologies/:id/edit, /anthologies/:id/submit, /anthologies/:id/evaluation, /anthologies/:anthologyId/sponsor, /submissions, /submissions/:id, /sponsor-pools, /notifications, /profile, /users/:id, /wallet, /store, /orders, /pay/:orderId, /pay/result/:orderId, /settings, /login

features.name: Nav item configuration array
features.description: ROUTE_NAV_ITEMS is a typed array of {path, label} objects that drives the navigation bar rendering dynamically.

features.name: Global QueryClient with optimized defaults
features.description: Singleton QueryClient with staleTime: 30s, gcTime: 5min, retry: 1, refetchOnWindowFocus: false.

features.name: Query key conventions
features.description: Consistent array-based query keys: ['anthology', id], ['submissions', id], ['ranking', id], ['wallet'], ['walletTransactions'], ['notifications'], ['following', userId], ['liked', targetType, targetId], ['likesCount', targetType, targetId], ['bookmarked', targetType, targetId], ['eval-config', id], ['transparency', id], ['auth', 'me'], ['payment-status', orderId], ['submission', id], ['submission-evaluation', id], ['submission-transparency', id]

features.name: Mutations with cache invalidation
features.description: useMutation with onSuccess → qc.invalidateQueries() for related query keys. FollowButton invalidates ['following', userId] + ['followers', targetUserId]. LikeButton invalidates ['liked',...] + ['likesCount',...]. StorePage buyMutation invalidates ['orders'].

features.name: Conditional query enabling
features.description: useQuery with enabled: !!user && ... guards to prevent queries when auth state is unknown.

features.name: Polling for payment status
features.description: refetchInterval: (q) => q.state.data?.status === 'paid' ? false : 2000 — polls every 2s until payment confirmed, then stops. retry: 30.

features.name: Select transform for derived data
features.description: useQuery with select option to transform raw following list into boolean isFollowing check.

features.name: Query-level loading/error/empty pattern
features.description: Every page destructures { data, isLoading, isError, error, refetch } and renders conditional states: isLoading → Skeleton, isError → QueryError with onRetry=refetch, empty → Empty component.

features.name: AuthContext with React Context
features.description: Provides user, isAuthenticated, isLoading, login(), logout(). Uses useQuery(['auth','me']) to fetch current session on mount. Manual user override via useState for optimistic login.

features.name: SMS verification code login
features.description: Phone number input → send code mutation → verify code mutation → authLogin(data.user). Countdown timer (60s) for resend. Client-side phone/code validation (regex).

features.name: WeChat OAuth login
features.description: WeChat green button (#07c160) triggers WeChat OAuth flow via /api/auth/login-with-wechat endpoint.

features.name: Dev login shortcut
features.description: handleDevLogin() for development environment only — auto-fills phone/code and calls /api/auth/dev-login. Guarded by import.meta.env.PROD check.

features.name: useAuth() convenience hook
features.description: Thin wrapper over useAuthContext() that exposes { user, isAuthenticated, isLoading, login, logout }.

features.name: Logout with server call + redirect
features.description: logout() clears manualUser, POSTs to /api/auth/logout with credentials, then navigates to /login.

features.name: API client 401 auto-redirect
features.description: api() function intercepts 401 responses and redirects to /login?next=<currentPath> for post-login redirect.

features.name: Bearer token auth header pattern
features.description: Consistent pattern: const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token'); fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })

features.name: Curator-only action guards
features.description: isCurator check (user.id === a.curatorId) gates status mutations, evaluate, retry evaluation, and sponsor pool management UI.

features.name: Like button with count
features.description: LikeButton component: checks liked status via /api/community/likes/check, shows count via /api/community/likes/count, toggles via POST /api/community/likes. Shows ♡/❤️ with active styling when liked.

features.name: Bookmark button with status
features.description: BookmarkButton: checks bookmarks for targetType, toggles via POST /api/community/bookmarks. Uses optimistic local state synced via useQuery.

features.name: Follow/unfollow button
features.description: FollowButton: checks if user is following target, toggles follow status. Hides when viewing own profile. Uses ['following', userId] query key.

features.name: Notification bell with dropdown
features.description: Bell icon with unread count badge (9+ cap). Dropdown with notification list, mark-as-read, mark-all-as-read. Click-outside-to-close via useRef + mousedown listener.

features.name: Notifications page (full)
features.description: Full-page notification list with mark individual as read, mark all as read, mark-all mutation. Unread items styled with left-border accent.

features.name: User profile page (public)
features.description: Displays avatar, nickname, bio, stats (submissions/sponsorships/anthologies counts), honor badge, submission list with like counts, anthology references, status badges.

features.name: Anthology list with filter tabs
features.description: List page with Segmented filter bar: all/open/closed/draft/final status filtering. Card grid layout with status badges, curator name, deadline, sponsor pool amount.

features.name: Anthology detail with tabs
features.description: Detail page with Segmented tab switcher: ranking tab and transparency tab (evaluation audit logs).

features.name: Anthology create/edit form
features.description: 34KB page with: title, description, AI system prompt with 5 prompt templates, deadline, max entries. Edit mode reuses same component.

features.name: Prompt templates system
features.description: PROMPT_TEMPLATES array with 5 pre-built evaluation prompts for different poetry genres (通用/古典/现代/情感/创意). Template selection buttons with active state.

features.name: Multi-model evaluation configuration
features.description: Enable multi-model evaluation with up to 5 AI models. Each model row: provider select, model select, weight (0-100), rounds (1-3), thinking depth (none/low/medium/high/max).

features.name: Sponsor pool configuration in create form
features.description: Optional sponsor pool toggle with target amount and distribution plan textarea.

features.name: Curator control panel
features.description: Context-sensitive action buttons: draft→open, open→closed, closed→final (with confirm dialog), evaluate, retry evaluation, manage sponsor pool.

features.name: Evaluation progress indicator
features.description: Progress bar showing evaluated/total submissions count. Color changes based on completion.

features.name: Evaluation result with ranking display
features.description: Ranking list with numbered badges (gold/silver/bronze for top 3). Each item shows author name, score, content excerpt, like button.

features.name: Transparency logs tab
features.description: Evaluation audit trail: provider/model, round number, score, duration, token counts, error states. Collapsible details with preformatted JSON.

features.name: Collapsible config section
features.description: Accordion-style section showing AI system prompt and evaluation model configuration with details/summary.

features.name: Submission form with content + statement
features.description: Content textarea (max 5000 chars), statement textarea (max 1000 chars, optional), char count display.

features.name: Pre-evaluation toggle in submission form
features.description: Optional checkbox to enable AI pre-evaluation before formal submission.

features.name: Submission detail with editing
features.description: View mode shows content + statement. Edit mode (owner only) allows modifying both fields. Save triggers automatic PK re-ranking.

features.name: PK re-ranking on edit
features.description: When editing a ranked submission, user can input opponent ranks. On save, system POSTs to /api/submissions/:id/pk to re-rank.

features.name: Rank selection algorithm
features.description: computeAutoRanks(): auto-selects 4 opponents including rank 1 and totalRanks, filling gaps evenly.

features.name: Pre-evaluation history with deletion
features.description: Shows all previous pre-evaluations with delete capability. Each shows group rank, score, PK opponents, expandable detail logs.

features.name: AI pre-evaluation with PK results
features.description: Shows groupRank/total, yourScore, PK group ranking table with opponent excerpts, scores, clickable navigation.

features.name: Evaluation audit logs per submission
features.description: Per-submission transparency logs: provider/model, round, score, duration, token counts, error states, collapsible full prompt and response JSON.

features.name: Thinking chain display
features.description: Collapsible thinking content with warm yellow background (#fef3c7), showing AI's reasoning chain per evaluation round.

features.name: Submission list page
features.description: List of user's submissions with status badges, content preview (3-line clamp), anthology link, creation date.

features.name: Floating AI assistant button
features.description: Fixed-position round button (48px, bottom-right) with 'AI' label. Opens slide-in chat panel.

features.name: Slide-in chat panel
features.description: Right-side panel (420px width) with backdrop overlay. Contains: model selector, message list with bubbles, input with Enter-to-send.

features.name: AI tool call integration
features.description: Chat responses can include toolCall with name='update_anthology'. Auto-updates form fields (title, description, aiSystemPrompt, deadline, maxEntries, sponsorPool, evaluationModels).

features.name: Chat model selector
features.description: Dropdown in chat header to select which AI model/provider to use. Populated from connected providers.

features.name: Retry on error
features.description: When AI response starts with '错误:', a retry button appears to resend the last user message.

features.name: Chat default model persistence
features.description: GET/PUT /api/settings/default-chat-model for persisting preferred chat model across sessions.

features.name: Wallet balance card with gradient
features.description: Gradient card (indigo→purple) showing balance in large text. Withdraw button expands inline form.

features.name: Withdraw form with method selection
features.description: Amount input, radio group for Alipay/WeChat Pay, account input. Client-side validation.

features.name: Transaction history list
features.description: List of wallet transactions with description, timestamp, amount (green for income, red for expense).

features.name: Store page with anthology grid
features.description: Grid of finalized anthologies with fixed price (¥9.90). Buy button creates order via POST /api/orders.

features.name: Orders page
features.description: Order list with order ID, status badges, item rows, total amount. Download button for purchased anthologies.

features.name: Payment page with method selection
features.description: Payment amount display, method list (Alipay/WeChat Pay) with radio selection, pay button.

features.name: Payment result polling page
features.description: Shows ⏳/✅ based on status. Polls every 2s until paid. Navigation links to orders, return URL, or browse.

features.name: Sponsor pool contribution
features.description: Pool stats (target/current/progress bar), sponsor list, contribution form, my sponsorship share percentage.

features.name: Sponsor pools list
features.description: List of user's sponsored pools with pool name, target/current amounts, anthology link, contribution amount.

features.name: Linaria zero-runtime CSS-in-JS
features.description: All components use css tagged template from @linaria/core. Styles extracted at build time — zero runtime cost.

features.name: CSS custom properties (design tokens)
features.description: Complete design token system: --haze-color-primary, --haze-color-bg, --haze-color-text, --haze-color-border, --haze-color-success/warning/danger/info, --haze-color-focus-ring.

features.name: Dark mode support
features.description: Full dark mode via .dark class on html. useTheme() hook toggles class. MutationObserver watches for external changes. System preference detection via matchMedia.

features.name: Shared style constants
features.description: Reusable style classes: primaryBtn (with hover/active/disabled), label, formGroup, grid (auto-fill responsive).

features.name: Global reset and base styles
features.description: Comprehensive reset: box-sizing, font smoothing, scrollbar customization, container responsive widths, utility classes (.sr-only, .truncate, .break-all, .font-mono).

features.name: haze-ui component library
features.description: Design system: Container, Title, Card, Empty, Button, Skeleton, Segmented, Spinner, Input, Textarea, Progress, Text, Switch, NavigationBar, NavLink, useToast.

features.name: Responsive grid system
features.description: Grid class: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)) with gap: 16px.

features.name: Gradient backgrounds
features.description: Consistent indigo→purple gradient (linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6)) on login, wallet, and home.

features.name: QueryError component
features.description: Reusable error display with danger-colored message and optional retry button.

features.name: FormError component
features.description: Inline form error message with danger color. Returns null when message is empty.

features.name: ErrorBoundary class component
features.description: React class ErrorBoundary with getDerivedStateFromError + componentDidCatch. Custom fallback or default with Try again button.

features.name: Toast notifications
features.description: Global toast singleton wrapping haze-ui's useToast. Provides toast.success/error/warning/info methods.

features.name: API error handling in client
features.description: ApiError class with status/message/data. api() extracts error from JSON body. 401 auto-redirect.

features.name: Mutation error handling pattern
features.description: Consistent: useMutation with onError → toast.error(err.message). Some use try/catch with manual setError state.

features.name: Loading skeleton pattern
features.description: Every data-fetching page renders Skeleton variants during loading: text for titles, rectangular for content.

features.name: Empty state pattern
features.description: haze-ui Empty component with descriptive text when lists return empty.

features.name: SEOHead component
features.description: Programmatic meta tag management: document.title, og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type. Creates/updates meta elements dynamically.

features.name: StatusBadge with color map
features.description: Maps status strings to colors (color-mix for subtle backgrounds) and Chinese labels. Covers: draft/open/closed/final/pending/paid/completed/cancelled/judging/accepted/rejected.

features.name: Exportable status maps
features.description: statusColors and statusLabels exported for reuse.

features.name: API Key management
features.description: Add/delete API keys with provider selection. AES-256 encryption. Auto model discovery. Provider search with model count.

features.name: Model discovery and management
features.description: Per-key model grid with search, pagination (40/page), individual toggle, batch enable/disable, select-all.

features.name: Default chat model selection
features.description: Dropdown to set default AI model for chat assistant from enabled models.

features.name: Dark mode toggle
features.description: Switch component for toggling dark mode via useTheme() hook.

features.name: Batch model operations
features.description: Batch enable/disable current page models via /api/settings/api-keys/:id/models/batch.

features.name: Profile page with avatar
features.description: Avatar (initial-based circular), nickname, bio, creation date. Edit mode with inline Input/Textarea.

features.name: Profile update mutation
features.description: PATCH /api/auth/profile with optimistic navigation. QueryClient invalidation on success.

features.name: Evaluation result page
features.description: Displays anthology evaluation rankings with rank badges, poem content, evaluation section, highlight items, like buttons.

features.name: Multi-model weighted evaluation
features.description: Supports multiple AI models with weights (0-100%), rounds (1-3), thinking depth (none/low/medium/high/max). Batch evaluation with retry.

features.name: PK (head-to-head) evaluation
features.description: Pairwise comparison: user selects opponent ranks, system runs head-to-head. Results show group rank, opponent ranking, detailed logs.

features.name: Evaluation transparency
features.description: Full audit trail: per-model logs with provider, model, round, score, duration, tokens, prompt, response, thinking, errors. Export JSON/CSV.

features.name: Evaluation config per anthology
features.description: Per-anthology model config with GET/PUT/DELETE. Default fallback: deepseek-chat.

features.name: Curator evaluation trigger
features.description: Curator can trigger or retry evaluation. Confirmation dialog before final status change.

features.name: Sticky navigation bar
features.description: position: sticky, top: 0, z-index: 100. NavigationBar with brand, links, create button, notification bell, avatar.

features.name: Click-outside dropdown dismissal
features.description: useRef + mousedown listener for notification dropdown.

features.name: Confirmation dialogs
features.description: window.confirm() before destructive actions (finalizing anthology).

features.name: Character count indicators
features.description: Real-time char count below textareas (e.g. '342/5000').

features.name: Card hover effects
features.description: translateY(-1px) + box-shadow transition on interactive cards.

features.name: Progress bar for evaluation status
features.description: Visual indicator showing evaluated vs total. Color changes on completion.

features.name: Segmented tab control
features.description: haze-ui Segmented for tab switching (ranking/transparency, status filters).

features.name: Collapsible details sections
features.description: Native <details>/<summary> for expandable AI prompts, responses, thinking chains.

features.name: Avatar initial-based design
features.description: Circular avatar showing first letter of nickname. Primary color background.

features.name: Status-based conditional UI
features.description: Different sections rendered based on anthology status: curator panel, submit button, evaluation trigger.
